FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the following posts purely on CONTRACT BASIS for Three
months only in a SIA project entitled “Social Impact Assessment (SIA) study for acquisition
of approx. 16.80 acres of Land of Three villages of Bhawanigarh Tehsil, Distt. Sangrur
(Punjab), for constructing Bhawanigarh minor 9, having approx. Length of 5.57 km and
approx. 40 feet width”, under section 4.1 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in
Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act (RFCTLARR)-2013. The interested
candidates can attend the walk-in interviews, along with their detailed bio-data and attested
copies of requisite qualification certificates and work experience, in the office of the
undersigned on 24th September at 12.00 noon.
1. Field/Research Investigators (02) - Two posts for 03 Months only
Essential qualifications:
i) Postgraduate in Anthropology or allied social sciences subjects with minimum 55% marks
for the General category candidates (& 50% in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii) The age of the candidate should be below 40 years
Desirable qualifications:
i) The candidate should possess knowledge of fieldwork and must be willing to conduct
independent fieldwork/data collection.
ii) Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of the Punjabi language.
Emoluments: Rs. 36,000/- per month (consolidated)
No T.A./D.A. is permissible for appearing in the interview.
Note: Please check the department website before appearing for the interview; there might be
a possibility of a change in the date and time of the interview.
Dr. JS Sehrawat
Assistant Professor & Principal Consultant
Department of Anthropology
Panjab University
Chandigarh-160014
